summary.note: Every verdict is model against model.

labels.claim_text: MX-LIMBs keep their full capacity through 1000 bending cycles
labels.observation: Capacity retention stays at ~97-100% through 1000 bending cycles
labels.observation_as_labelled: Capacity retention stays at ~97-100% through 1000 bending cycles
labels.why: The observation shows capacity retention of ~97-100% through 1000 cycles, which strongly supports but does not exactly establish 'full capacity' since the range dips below 100% at some points.
unsettled: whether capacity is literally 100% (full) rather than 97-99% at various points in the cycling
performance beyond 1000 cycles
mechanism or cause of the retention

labels.claim_text: Discharge voltage of TKL is unchanged under light
labels.observation: Light discharge curve overlaps the dark curves along the 2.4-2.0 V plateau
labels.observation_as_labelled: Light discharge curve overlaps the dark curves along the 2.4-2.0 V plateau
labels.why: The observation confirms voltage overlap specifically along the 2.4-2.0 V plateau region, which supports but does not fully establish the broader claim that discharge voltage is unchanged under light across the entire discharge profile.
unsettled: voltage behavior outside the 2.4-2.0 V plateau (e.g., initial drop, tail/cutoff region)
whether the match holds across multiple cycles or extended time under light
whether other discharge parameters (capacity, rate) are also unaffected

labels.claim_text: Strain at the twin boundaries lengthens Cu-O and Cu-La bonds, strengthening CO* binding and promoting C-C coupling to C2H4
labels.observation: CO2 desorbs at 418 C from the NBs and 408 C from the NRs, and bulk adds a broad peak near 580 C, so CO2 binding ranks bulk > NBs > NRs, opposite to C2H4 selectivity
labels.observation_as_labelled: CO2 desorbs at 418 C from the NBs and 408 C from the NRs, and bulk adds a broad peak near 580 C, so CO2 binding ranks bulk > NBs > NRs, opposite to C2H4 selectivity
labels.why: The TPD data show CO2 desorption/binding strength ranks bulk > NBs > NRs, the reverse of the C2H4 selectivity order, which undercuts the claim's core logic that stronger binding of a carbon-oxygen intermediate at the strained twin-boundary sites drives C-C coupling to C2H4, even though the measured species here is CO2 rather than the CO* intermediate the claim specifically invokes.
unsettled: whether Cu-O and Cu-La bond lengths actually change at twin boundaries
whether CO* (as opposed to CO2) binding strength is enhanced at NBs/NRs
the mechanistic link between any binding trend and C-C coupling to C2H4
why CO2 binding and C2H4 selectivity trends diverge across bulk/NBs/NRs

labels.claim_text: Grafted BVLD keeps its anti-thrombin bioactivity: thrombin specific activity is roughly halved on BVLD-bearing coatings
labels.observation: Thrombin specific activity ~0.65e-3 abs/ng/cm2 on BVLD-PPAmF and BVLD/NO-PPAmF vs ~1.3e-3 on 316L SS, PPAmF and NO-PPAmF (***)
labels.observation_as_labelled: Thrombin specific activity ~0.65e-3 abs/ng/cm2 on BVLD-PPAmF and BVLD/NO-PPAmF vs ~1.3e-3 on 316L SS, PPAmF and NO-PPAmF (***)
labels.why: The observation directly reports the quantitative thrombin specific activity values on BVLD-bearing coatings (~0.65e-3) versus non-BVLD controls (~1.3e-3) with significance markers, matching exactly the roughly-halved activity described in the claim.

labels.claim_text: Under 660 nm light (100 mW cm-2) bismuthene generates singlet oxygen
labels.observation: Relative DPBF absorbance falls to ~0.73 in 30 min with bismuthene vs ~0.93 in water
labels.observation_as_labelled: Relative DPBF absorbance falls to ~0.73 in 30 min with bismuthene vs ~0.93 in water
labels.why: The faster DPBF absorbance decay with bismuthene versus water indicates ROS generation consistent with singlet oxygen production under illumination, but the observation alone (without a singlet-oxygen-specific control like an azide quencher or direct 1O2 luminescence) does not confirm the light was specifically 660 nm at 100 mW cm-2 or that the reactive species is singlet oxygen rather than another ROS.
unsettled: confirmation that 660 nm/100 mW cm-2 conditions were used
specificity of DPBF response to singlet oxygen versus other ROS
quantitative singlet oxygen yield or mechanism

labels.claim_text: Energy diagram places TKL LUMO (-3.7 eV) above the collector (-4.3 eV) and Li-TKL HOMO (-5.9 eV) above TKL HOMO (-6.5 eV)
labels.observation: DFT gives TKL ionization potential 6.51 eV and electron affinity 3.72 eV
labels.observation_as_labelled: DFT gives TKL ionization potential 6.51 eV and electron affinity 3.72 eV
labels.why: The DFT-derived IP (6.51 eV) and EA (3.72 eV) numerically reproduce the claim's TKL HOMO (-6.5 eV) and LUMO (-3.7 eV) values via an independent computational method, but say nothing about the collector's -4.3 eV level, the Li-TKL HOMO at -5.9 eV, or the claimed relative orderings (LUMO above collector, Li-TKL HOMO above TKL HOMO).
unsettled: collector energy level (-4.3 eV)
Li-TKL HOMO value (-5.9 eV)
ordering: TKL LUMO above collector
ordering: Li-TKL HOMO above TKL HOMO

labels.claim_text: Rutile fraction falls with increasing Ce content in the co-doped series
labels.observation: Rutile (R) reflections are clear for Er0.5Ce0.1, faint for Ce0.2 and absent for Ce0.3; anatase (A) reflections in all
labels.observation_as_labelled: Rutile (R) reflections are clear for Er0.5Ce0.1, faint for Ce0.2 and absent for Ce0.3; anatase (A) reflections in all
labels.why: The observation shows a monotonic qualitative decline in rutile peak visibility (clear to faint to absent) as Ce content rises across the co-doped series, which supports the trend of decreasing rutile presence but does not quantify a 'fraction' (e.g., via Rietveld or intensity-ratio analysis) to establish the specific magnitude of the decrease.
unsettled: quantitative rutile fraction values at each Ce level
whether the trend holds beyond the three sampled Ce contents (0.1, 0.2, 0.3)
anatase fraction change to confirm relative phase balance

labels.observation_as_labelled: AQY falls with wavelength, 18.3% at 400 nm to 0.19% at 550 nm, tracking the absorption edge
labels.why: The observation establishes a decreasing AQY trend with wavelength (18.3% at 400 nm to 0.19% at 550 nm) consistent with the general shape of the claim, but does not report or pin down the specific 15.8% value at 420 nm.
unsettled: exact AQY value at 420 nm
whether 420 nm falls precisely at 15.8% within the trend

labels.claim_text: x=0.06 releases its stored energy as a fast pulse (t0.9 ~0.1 us)

labels.observation_as_labelled: Wd plateaus ~0.02, 0.10, 0.25, 0.44 J/cm3 at 20-80 kV/cm, most of it released by the 0.1 us marker
labels.why: The observation shows discharge energy densities plateauing across field strengths with most of the energy already released by the 0.1 us mark, which is consistent with a fast-pulse release but only approximates rather than precisely pins down the t0.9~0.1us metric or confirms it specifically for x=0.06.
unsettled: precise quantitative value of t0.9 (90% release time) rather than 'most' released
explicit confirmation that this data corresponds to the x=0.06 composition
whether release timing is fast across the full field range or only at select points

labels.claim_text: Co is incorporated into the scaffolds: Co/Ca 0 (MBG), 0.14 (2Co-MBG), 0.49 (5Co-MBG)
labels.observation: EDS: no Co peak with Co/Ca = 0 in b; Co peak near 6.9 keV in d and f, labelled Co/Ca = 0.14 and 0.49
labels.observation_as_labelled: EDS: no Co peak with Co/Ca = 0 in b; Co peak near 6.9 keV in d and f, labelled Co/Ca = 0.14 and 0.49

unsettled: quantitative derivation of the exact Co/Ca values 0.14 and 0.49 from peak intensities
confirmation that the labelled ratios were independently measured rather than assumed/reported

labels.claim_text: At 0.5C and 45 C, LiFePO4 cells with PEOm-Li21Si5 retain ~111 mAh/g after 200 cycles

labels.observation_as_labelled: 0.5C at 45 C: ~140 mAh/g falls to ~111 mAh/g after 200 cycles, Coulombic efficiency ~100%
labels.why: The observation directly reports the same test condition (0.5C, 45 C) and the same capacity retention value (~111 mAh/g after 200 cycles from ~140 mAh/g start), matching the claim's specific numeric and condition assertion.

labels.claim_text: Dox-MVs plus aPD-L1 cut lung metastasis to 1.6 nodules per lung in the i.v. 4T1 model
labels.observation: Lung nodules fall to 1.6 per lung against 22.2 for PBS plus aPD-L1 and 5.2-11.2 for the others
labels.observation_as_labelled: Lung nodules fall to 1.6 per lung against 22.2 for PBS plus aPD-L1 and 5.2-11.2 for the others
labels.why: The observation reports the exact 1.6 nodules-per-lung value for the treatment group named in the claim, distinguished from the 22.2 PBS+aPD-L1 control and the 5.2-11.2 range of other groups, directly pinning down the quantity the claim asserts.

labels.claim_text: The arch geometry takes up substrate stretching by straightening, relaxing strain in the NW
labels.observation: Optical micrographs: arch height drops at 50% and the NW is nearly straight at 100% stretch, unbroken
labels.observation_as_labelled: Optical the data: arch height drops at 50% and the NW is nearly straight at 100% stretch, unbroken
labels.why: The optical data directly shows the arch geometry flattening (height drop at 50%, near-straight at 100%) as substrate stretch increases, which evidences the arch-straightening mechanism, but the observation only shows the NW remains unbroken rather than directly measuring or confirming strain relaxation within the NW itself.
unsettled: direct measurement of strain magnitude in the NW (e.g., via diffraction or spectroscopy)
quantitative link between arch straightening and reduced NW strain
behavior beyond 100% stretch or reversibility of the strain relief

labels.observation: Bismuthene Bi 4f: Bi0 doublet (~156.8/162.1 eV) grown vs the oxide, but the Bi3+ (Bi2O3) doublet still has the larger area
labels.observation_as_labelled: Bismuthene Bi 4f: Bi0 doublet (~156.8/162.1 eV) grown vs the oxide, but the Bi3+ (Bi2O3) doublet still has the larger area

unsettled: exact 12:5 area ratio
quantification of oxide vs metallic fractions
heterostructure structural interpretation beyond XPS area comparison

labels.claim_text: T_P-R falls monotonically with BNT, from ~365 C at x=0 to ~160-175 C at x=0.12-0.15

labels.observation_as_labelled: T_P-R permittivity step moves from ~365 C (x=0) to ~270 C (0.05), ~205 C (0.1) and ~160-175 C (0.12-0.15)
labels.why: The observation reports T_P-R values at x=0 (365C), 0.05 (270C), 0.1 (205C), and 0.12-0.15 (160-175C), directly showing a monotonic decrease across the compositional range with endpoints matching the claim exactly.

labels.claim_text: PBA crystal structure preserved over 250 cycles (no amorphization)

labels.observation_as_labelled: XRD: PBA peaks (~17.5, 35, 39.5 deg) persist unchanged from pristine to 250th cycle; no new peaks
labels.why: The observation shows the characteristic PBA XRD peaks unchanged in position/presence from pristine through 250 cycles with no new peaks, directly confirming retained crystallinity and absence of amorphization over that exact cycle count.

labels.observation_as_labelled: Cross-section: continuous mat of intertwined fibers between the dashed film boundaries, no discrete layer interfaces

labels.claim_text: Mg-Zn-Y-Nd is much softer than 317L SS: microhardness about 54 vs 199 HV

labels.observation_as_labelled: Microhardness ranks 317L SS (198.7 +/- 9.9 HV) far above Mg-Zn-Y-Nd (54.3 +/- 2.5 HV)

labels.observation_as_labelled: EBSD red (FCC) area is about 70% of classified pixels, green (BCC) about 30%

whether pixel-area fraction equals volume fraction
identification of BCC as B2-ordered phase

labels.observation_as_labelled: Lattice fringes d = 0.36 nm labelled CdS (100)

confirmation of hexagonal (vs. cubic) phase via additional planes/pattern
absence of Cu diffraction peak

labels.claim_text: NixPyOz is largely amorphous with weak nickel phosphite (Ni2(PO3)4) features, unlike crystalline Ni-MOF
labels.observation: NixPyOz humps only partly coincide with JCPDS:04-010-2575 sticks; strong reference lines near 14.5 and 28 deg lack counterparts
labels.observation_as_labelled: NixPyOz humps only partly coincide with JCPDS:04-010-2575 sticks; strong reference lines near 14.5 and 28 deg lack counterparts
labels.why: The partial and weak overlap between NixPyOz humps and the Ni2(PO3)4 reference sticks (missing strong 14.5/28 deg lines) supports the claim's characterization of NixPyOz as largely amorphous with only weak nickel phosphite features, but the observation does not compare this to or characterize the crystallinity of the Ni-MOF reference material.
unsettled: comparison to Ni-MOF crystallinity
whether Ni-MOF shows sharp crystalline peaks

labels.claim_text: As-cast alloy is dual-phase ordered FCC (L12) plus ordered BCC (B2)
labels.observation: SAED of lamella A indexed FCC [011], lamella B BCC [011], each with circled superlattice spots
labels.observation_as_labelled: SAED of lamella A indexed FCC [011], lamella B BCC [011], each with circled superlattice spots
labels.why: The SAED patterns confirm two distinct lamellae with FCC and BCC parent lattices and demonstrate ordering via superlattice reflections, which is consistent with L12 and B2 respectively, but the observation does not by itself uniquely confirm the specific L12/B2 ordering type (versus other possible ordered variants) nor establish that this dual-phase FCC+BCC ordered structure is representative of the bulk as-cast microstructure rather than just two selected lamellae.
unsettled: confirmation that superlattice spots specifically correspond to L12 (not another FCC-based ordered structure)
confirmation that superlattice spots specifically correspond to B2 (not another BCC-based ordered structure)
whether the two imaged lamellae are representative of the overall as-cast alloy microstructure
relative phase fractions or volume distribution of the two phases

labels.claim_text: ZHSH flakes form on Zn soaked 7 days in both blank and NH4+-added electrolytes
labels.observation: Strong ~8.5 deg and weaker ~17, ~26 deg reflections indexed to Zn4SO4(OH)6·4H2O beside Zn peaks, for blank and NH4+
labels.observation_as_labelled: Strong ~8.5 deg and weaker ~17, ~26 deg reflections indexed to Zn4SO4(OH)6·4H2O beside Zn peaks, for blank and NH4+
labels.why: The XRD reflections confirm that Zn4SO4(OH)6·4H2O (ZHSH) forms as a phase alongside Zn metal in both blank and NH4+-added electrolytes, but XRD indexing establishes chemical/crystallographic identity, not the flake morphology or the specific 7-day soak timing named in the claim.
unsettled: flake morphology (requires imaging, e.g. SEM, not shown by XRD)
confirmation that this is specifically the 7-day soak sample

labels.claim_text: NH4+ adsorbs on Zn preferentially over Zn2+, forming an electrostatic shield that prevents agglomerated Zn deposition
labels.observation: Binding energy on Zn(101): NH4+ -2.10 eV vs Zn2+ -0.99 eV
labels.observation_as_labelled: Binding energy on Zn(101): NH4+ -2.10 eV vs Zn2+ -0.99 eV
labels.why: The DFT binding energies show NH4+ adsorbs more strongly than Zn2+ on Zn(101), directly evidencing the preferential adsorption part of the claim, but do not measure whether this adsorption actually forms an electrostatic shielding layer or whether it results in prevention of agglomerated Zn deposition.
unsettled: formation of an electrostatic shield/layer
the causal link to preventing agglomerated Zn deposition
coverage/kinetics of adsorption under real electrolyte conditions

labels.claim_text: Ag and Pd form an interacting alloy: electron density redistributes between Ag and Pd in Ag0.25Pd0.75-ZIS
labels.observation: Lattice fringes labelled Pd(111) 0.224 nm and a separate green-marked Ag spacing on distinct particles; no intermediate alloy spacing is marked
labels.observation_as_labelled: Lattice fringes labelled Pd(111) 0.224 nm and a separate green-marked Ag spacing on distinct particles; no intermediate alloy spacing is marked
labels.why: The observation shows Pd(111) and Ag lattice spacings resolved separately on distinct particles with no intermediate/shifted alloy spacing marked, which is more consistent with phase-segregated Ag and Pd domains than with a homogeneous alloy exhibiting interfacial electron density redistribution.
unsettled: whether any interfacial charge transfer occurs at Ag-Pd contact points
spectroscopic or compositional evidence (e.g., XPS binding energy shifts) for electron redistribution
whether alloying occurs at scales below HRTEM resolution or at particle boundaries not imaged

labels.observation_as_labelled: Composite reflections indexed to ZrB2 and SiC, with weak WSi2 and ZrO2 marks

unsettled: absence of starting-powder peaks (reaction completeness)

labels.observation_as_labelled: An amorphous layer labelled 'Passive layer', 1.0 nm thick in one region and 2.0 nm in the other, lies on lattice fringes of 0.48 nm spacing
labels.why: The observation confirms an amorphous surface layer of 1.0-2.0 nm thickness on lattice fringes consistent with an NCM particle, matching the claim's thickness and amorphous nature, but the layer is only labelled 'Passive layer' and its chemical identity as LiTMPO4 is not established by this imaging observation alone.
unsettled: chemical composition/identity as LiTMPO4
confirmation that the lattice fringes belong specifically to NCM

labels.claim_text: Co5Fe3Cr2 (oxy)hydroxide is low-crystalline (near-amorphous)
labels.observation: Crumpled, overlapping nanosheets with no visible lattice fringes
labels.observation_as_labelled: Crumpled, overlapping nanosheets with no visible lattice fringes
labels.why: The absence of visible lattice fringes in the crumpled nanosheets is consistent with poor long-range crystalline order and supports the low-crystalline/near-amorphous claim, but a single HRTEM-type observation without diffraction data (e.g., SAED/XRD) does not fully establish the degree of crystallinity or confirm the material is near-amorphous throughout rather than just locally disordered in the imaged region.
unsettled: confirmation via diffraction (SAED/XRD) that no or diffuse crystalline reflections are present
whether the whole Co5Fe3Cr2 (oxy)hydroxide sample is uniformly near-amorphous or only the imaged region
degree of crystallinity (fully amorphous vs. low-crystalline/nanocrystalline)

labels.claim_text: Bismuthene is a heterojunction: hexagonal Bi nanoflakes (5-25 nm) on Bi2O3 nanosheets
labels.observation: Bismuthene reflections index to hexagonal Bi (PDF#05-0519) plus one Bi2O3 (321) peak near 33 deg; the oxide indexes to PDF#45-1344
labels.observation_as_labelled: Bismuthene reflections index to hexagonal Bi (PDF#05-0519) plus one Bi2O3 (321) peak near 33 deg; the oxide indexes to PDF#45-1344

unsettled: particle size range of Bi nanoflakes
nanosheet morphology of Bi2O3
spatial/interfacial arrangement constituting a heterojunction

labels.claim_text: The wavy deformation bands are deformation kink bands: their crystal rotation angle varies continuously from ~5 to ~55 deg instead of taking the fixed ~85 deg of {10-12} twins
labels.observation: SAED taken at the four marked points A-D across successive kink bands: the c-axis direction differs strongly between neighbouring bands (about 60, 180, 40 and 10 deg from horizontal)
labels.observation_as_labelled: SAED taken at the four marked points A-D across successive kink bands: the c-axis direction differs strongly between neighbouring bands (about 60, 180, 40 and 10 deg from horizontal)
labels.why: The SAED measurements show the c-axis orientation varies substantially and non-uniformly between neighboring bands (60/180/40/10 deg), which is consistent with continuous, variable rotation rather than a single fixed twin angle, but the raw values do not directly establish the specific ~5-55 deg range claimed or explicitly rule out the ~85 deg {10-12} twin value.
unsettled: whether the actual point-to-point rotation angles fall specifically within the 5-55 deg range
explicit comparison/exclusion of the fixed ~85 deg twin misorientation
whether the variation is truly continuous across the band width rather than just differing at four discrete points

labels.claim_text: As-cast alloy consists of alpha-Mg, the Mg-Zn-La ternary T-phase and a small amount of Mg-Zn binary phase

labels.observation_as_labelled: XRD: strong reflections indexed to alpha-Mg, weak peaks at ~25 and ~52 deg to Mg-Zn-La, faint ~40 and ~43.5 deg to Mg-Zn
labels.why: The XRD peak indexing directly identifies all three phases named in the claim (alpha-Mg, Mg-Zn-La T-phase, Mg-Zn binary phase) and their relative peak intensities (strong, weak, faint) correspond to the claim's qualitative amounts (matrix phase, present phase, small amount phase), so the observation alone accounts for the full claim.

labels.claim_text: Nanoassemblies are hexagonal 2H-MoS2 for all Mo:S ratios, no secondary phase

labels.observation_as_labelled: SAED rings indexed (100), (103), (105), (110): polycrystalline hexagonal MoS2
labels.why: The indexed SAED rings confirm the polycrystalline phase present is hexagonal 2H-MoS2 with no extraneous rings visible, but a single diffraction pattern does not establish that this holds across all Mo:S ratios or definitively rule out minor/amorphous secondary phases below detection limits.
unsettled: confirmation across all Mo:S ratios
absence of secondary phase at every composition
detection limit for minor secondary phases not visible as distinct rings

labels.claim_text: Ag and Pd form an interacting alloy: electron density redistributes between Ag and Pd in Ag0.25Pd0.75-ZIS

labels.observation_as_labelled: Ag0.25Pd0.75-ZIS: Ag 3d marginally higher, Pd 3d marginally lower binding energy than Ag-ZIS and Pd-ZIS

magnitude/quantitative extent of electron redistribution
whether the interaction is alloying versus interfacial/heterojunction contact

whether fcc Co and this carbon are the only phases present
spatial/structural relationship (C@Co core-shell arrangement)

whether Al2Ca is the only new phase in LA91-0.2Ca
composition/identity confirmation of the Al2Ca phase

specific ID/IG ratio values (1.19 vs 1.17)
quantitative near-equality of graphitization between the two carbons

labels.claim_text: Only ZnO and NiCo2O4 phases are present in all three samples; no impurity phase

labels.observation_as_labelled: Lattice fringes 0.26 nm apart in the region labelled ZnO

consistency across all three samples
absence of impurity phases in regions not imaged

Co persistence after hydrogenation (as opposed to dehydrogenation)
absence of reaction products across the full de/hydrogenation cycle

labels.claim_text: The nanocrystals are polycrystalline tetragonal rutile SnO2 (JCPDS 41-1445)

unsettled: exact match to JCPDS 41-1445 lattice parameters/d-spacings
phase purity / absence of other SnO2 or Sn-oxide polymorphs
quantitative confirmation of tetragonal rutile unit cell

quasi-reversible recovery on cooling

whether any intermetallic phase forms
the correct compositional identity of FCC_1 vs FCC_2

labels.claim_text: Quasi-steady nanowear rate is lowest for Al/Cu and highest for Al/Mg
labels.observation: At 2 wear cycles Al/Ti (~0.013) wears less than the harder Al/Cu (~0.018 um^3/cycle)
labels.observation_as_labelled: At 2 wear cycles Al/Ti (~0.013) wears less than the harder Al/Cu (~0.018 um^3/cycle)
labels.why: The observation shows that at an early transient stage (2 cycles, not the quasi-steady regime) the harder Al/Cu wears more than Al/Ti, which narrows the claim by indicating the Al/Cu-lowest ordering is specific to the quasi-steady state and does not hold at early cycles, while it says nothing about Al/Mg or the quasi-steady values themselves.
unsettled: whether Al/Cu is lowest at quasi-steady state
whether Al/Mg is highest at quasi-steady state
relative ranking of Al/Ti versus Al/Cu once quasi-steady state is reached

labels.claim_text: Cu(II) and MoO3 together turn H2O2 into hydroxyl radicals far faster than either centre alone
labels.observation: The oxTMB band near 652 nm appears only for TMB+H2O2+Cu(II)+MoO3 (A about 0.60); the other three traces stay below 0.1
labels.observation_as_labelled: The oxTMB band near 652 nm appears only for TMB+H2O2+Cu(II)+MoO3 (A about 0.60); the other three traces stay below 0.1
labels.why: The single-timepoint absorbance jump only for the Cu(II)+MoO3+H2O2 combination versus flat traces for the other conditions evidences a strong synergy in oxidizing TMB, but a one-point endpoint reading does not quantify reaction rate ("far faster") and TMB oxidation is a generic ROS/peroxidase-mimic readout rather than a specific identification of hydroxyl radicals (which would need EPR/spin-trapping or scavenger controls).
unsettled: quantitative rate comparison ("far faster") rather than single endpoint signal
specific chemical identity of the reactive species as hydroxyl radicals vs other ROS
whether the two unspecified other conditions correspond to Cu(II) alone and MoO3 alone as implied

labels.claim_text: A10 RNA aptamer-FITC-BSA@ZIF-8 reaches the prostate tumour in higher amount than the neat MOF after tail-vein injection

labels.observation_as_labelled: Ex vivo organ imaging: the tumour field is brighter for the A10 aptamer MOF than for the neat MOF
labels.why: The observation shows a qualitative brightness difference in ex vivo tumour imaging favoring the aptamer-MOF over the neat MOF, which supports greater tumour accumulation but does not establish a quantified 'amount' or control for possible differences in FITC labeling density/quantum yield between the two constructs.
unsettled: quantitative measure of amount (e.g., %ID/g) rather than qualitative brightness
whether FITC labeling efficiency is equivalent between aptamer-MOF and neat MOF
statistical significance and reproducibility across animals
whether difference is specific to the tumour versus general biodistribution changes

labels.claim_text: Ionic conductivity at intermediate temperature peaks at x = 0.175

labels.observation_as_labelled: At 200 C the x = 0.175 impedance arc is smallest (~9 kOhm) against 20-28 kOhm for other x

unsettled: whether the peak holds across the full intermediate-temperature range, not just 200 C
whether all relevant x values (fine composition grid) were tested to confirm 0.175 is the true optimum
precise quantitative conductivity values rather than qualitative arc-size comparison

whether the flat slab eventually binds or penetrates given more time

labels.why: The observation directly reports that at day 16 both V-POD-M+H2O2 and vancomycin wounds present as closed pink scars, matching each other while control and H2O2-only wounds remain open and crusted, which directly evidences equivalent wound closure by day 16 for the two treatments as claimed.

chemical identity of domains as epoxy (BMI-derived) phase

labels.claim_text: The flake surface is a network of ferroelectric CIPS lamellae embedded in a paraelectric IPS matrix

labels.observation_as_labelled: At 80 kV/cm the peak discharge current is ~8.7-10.3 A from 20 to 80 C
labels.why: The observation reports the actual peak discharge current values (8.7-10.3 A) across the full 20-80 C range at 80 kV/cm, which is a narrow spread (~16% variation) directly confirming the claimed rough stability over that temperature range.

labels.claim_text: Initial barrier resistance of epoxy rises with 0.1 and 0.3 loading, but not with 0.5
labels.observation: Day-1 Nyquist plots: single arc for -0.1 and -0.3; EP and -0.5 already show a low-frequency tail

labels.why: The single-arc vs. tailed Nyquist shapes qualitatively distinguish 0.1/0.3 loadings (capacitive, high-barrier behavior) from EP and 0.5 (diffusion-tail behavior resembling baseline), which is consistent with the claimed pattern but does not quantify the actual rise in barrier resistance values needed to confirm the loading-dependent trend.

direct confirmation that 0.5 resistance equals or falls below the EP baseline rather than just sharing tail shape
whether the trend persists beyond day 1

unsettled: whether volume change was measured or excluded as a contributing factor
link between oxidation degree and capacity fading magnitude
comparison specifically isolating volume-change effects

whether free volume or porosity was reduced
the causal mechanism linking particle state to the impedance differences
identity/composition differences among S2, S3, S4, and blank

labels.claim_text: As-synthesized formula Na0.4(VO)3[Fe(CN)6]2.12H2O with vanadyl ions and zeolitic/ligand water

labels.why: The FTIR bands identify the expected structural fragments (CN stretch near 2100 cm-1 consistent with Fe(CN)6, sharp band near 980 cm-1 consistent with V=O vanadyl stretch, low-frequency bands below 650 cm-1 consistent with M-CN bending, and broad 3430 cm-1 band consistent with O-H of water) but cannot pin down the precise stoichiometric formula (Na0.4, 2.12 H2O content) named in the claim.

exact water content (2.12 H2O)
overall elemental/compositional formula confirmation

labels.observation_as_labelled: Polarization voltage climbs from 0.090 to 0.223 V over 100 cycles for NCM-0 but only to 0.171 and 0.174 V for NCM-2 and NCM-3
